ACC-001.name: Low initial entropy is expected rather than anomalous
ACC-001.notes: NON-PROGRESSIVE by construction: the low-entropy past was known before the claim. It demonstrates coherence, not evidence. Promotion requires finding a QUANTITATIVE consequence of "specified order" that continuous-history cosmology does not permit.
ACC-001.risk_if_false: Nothing downstream. Accommodations carry no load in the ladder.
ACC-001.rival_account: Standard cosmology treats the low-entropy boundary condition as a genuine open problem (Penrose's Weyl curvature hypothesis; Carroll-Chen; inflationary measure arguments). It is an acknowledged explanatory debt, not a solved point - which is why accommodating it is cheap and does not by itself distinguish the programmes.
ACC-001.statement: Intentional creation specifies order before entropy increases under ordinary physical law, so the universe's exceptionally low-entropy initial state is a design parameter rather than a statistical improbability requiring explanation.

ACC-002.name: Redshift as created geometry plus evolution
ACC-002.notes: NON-PROGRESSIVE as stated. The (1+z) light-curve time dilation cross-check is the sharp point here and is registered as OPN-010; a created-geometry model that reproduces it quantitatively would be the programme's first real content.
ACC-002.rival_account: Standard cosmology derives redshift from FLRW metric expansion, with the distance-redshift relation independently constrained by Type Ia supernovae, BAO, and the CMB, and cross-checked by the observed (1+z) time dilation of supernova light curves. The rival's account is quantitative and multiply constrained; CAC's is presently neither.
ACC-002.statement: Observed cosmological redshift is accommodated as the joint result of the metric structure established at Day Four and subsequent ordinary evolution, rather than as evidence for a continuous multi-Gyr expansion history.

ACC-003.name: The Hubble tension is conceptually unsurprising
ACC-003.notes: NON-PROGRESSIVE, and the weakest of the five. "Expect discrepancies" is compatible with ANY observed discrepancy including none, and with any magnitude or sign. The paper's use of the word "predicts" here should be read as accommodation; per research-practices.md #1 the wording is a candidate correction for v0.2. Promotion requires deriving a magnitude or a sign for the early-late offset.
ACC-003.rival_account: Standard cosmology treats the tension as either unresolved systematics or a signal of new physics (early dark energy, varying Neff, modified recombination), with active programmes on each. Note that the rival's versions PREDICT specific parameter shifts and are being tested; "systematic discrepancies may appear" predicts no value and no sign.
ACC-003.statement: If creation involved a discrete cosmological actualization, attempts to reconstruct cosmic history from present observations may produce systematic discrepancies. The disagreement between early- and late-universe determinations of H0 is therefore expected rather than anomalous.

ACC-004.name: High-redshift structural maturity is expected
ACC-004.notes: NON-PROGRESSIVE. Also the most volatile: it rests on a live literature that has moved AGAINST the strong form of the anomaly since 2022-2023 (research-practices.md #5). Building weight on it is a standing risk. Promotion requires a stated maturity DISTRIBUTION versus redshift that differs from the LCDM expectation and is testable against a defined sample.
ACC-004.rival_account: Early JWST claims of over-massive high-z galaxies have been substantially moderated by improved photometric calibration, spectroscopic follow-up, AGN contamination corrections, and revised IMF/dust assumptions. Within LCDM the surviving tension is modest. The paper itself concedes this moderation, which is correct and should be kept.
ACC-004.statement: Apparent maturity at great cosmological distance need not correspond to billions of years of uninterrupted developmental history. Structural maturity is an expected consequence of creation in functional maturity.

ACC-005.name: Some dark-sector inference may reflect creation boundary conditions
ACC-005.notes: NON-PROGRESSIVE and the most exposed of the five. The paper correctly labels it "a hypothesis requiring mathematical development." The rival_account above is the specific form that development must take; until then the claim should not be cited as support.
ACC-005.rival_account: Dark matter is constrained by independent lines that are not reconstructions of history: galactic rotation curves, cluster velocity dispersions, strong and weak lensing, the Bullet Cluster mass-light separation, and the CMB third-peak amplitude. A history-artifact account must address the non-historical lines, especially lensing and the Bullet Cluster, which are present-epoch observations.
ACC-005.statement: Some inferred dark-sector phenomena may represent artifacts of reconstructing a continuous history from a universe possessing divinely specified initial conditions. The gravitational observations themselves are not denied.

CRE-001.name: Genesis records genuine historical events
CRE-001.notes: Immune by methodological DECISION, not by necessity (hard-core.md). The warrant is exegetical and theological and is argued on those grounds, not asserted as scientific.
CRE-001.risk_if_false: The programme has no boundary condition to substitute for the standard model's continuous 13.8 Gyr history, and every downstream claim loses its ground. Total loss.
CRE-001.statement: The biblical creation narrative is a historically reliable account of what occurred, not myth, allegory, or a purely literary framework. Present observations therefore need not encode an uninterrupted natural history.

CRE-002.name: Creation is divine actualization, not the culmination of prior natural process
CRE-002.risk_if_false: Without discreteness the programme collapses into a theistic gloss on continuous-history cosmology, which is not an alternative research programme and forbids nothing LCDM permits.
CRE-002.statement: The created order is brought into being by a divine act rather than as the terminus of a preceding natural process. There is no natural history behind Creation Week.

CRE-003.name: Functional maturity of the created order
CRE-003.risk_if_false: Without maturity the discrete act (CRE-002) leaves an inoperable universe, and the bridge to cosmology (CRE-006) has nothing to extend.
CRE-003.statement: Creation possesses functional maturity: the created order existed in operational completeness rather than developmental infancy. Adam was created a mature man; fruit trees bore fruit.

CRE-004.name: Day Four actualizes the observable heavens into their operational state
CRE-004.notes: The axiom fixes THAT the heavens were actualized; it does not fix the mechanism (open, OPN-001/OPN-002) nor the specific exegesis of the day (belt, HER-002).
CRE-004.risk_if_false: The cosmological content of the programme is carried almost entirely by this axiom. If Day Four is not the actualization of the observable heavens, CAC has a doctrine of terrestrial creation and no cosmology.
CRE-004.statement: Day Four represents the actualization of the observable heavens into their operational state as reckoned from Earth's historical frame. Genesis establishes their covenantal functions rather than supplying an astrophysical chronology.

CRE-005.name: Stable intelligible physical law after Creation Week
CRE-005.risk_if_false: Without it the programme cannot be tested at all: any observation could be attributed to ongoing miracle, which is the unfalsifiability charge in its strongest form. This is the axiom that makes CAC a candidate research programme rather than a position.
CRE-005.statement: Following Creation Week the universe operates under stable, intelligible physical laws. Miracle characterizes creation itself; science characterizes providence thereafter.

CRE-006.name: Functional maturity extends to cosmology
CRE-006.risk_if_false: This is the bridge that makes the core cosmological rather than merely theological. Without it CRE-003 is a claim about Eden and implies nothing about the observable universe.
CRE-006.statement: The maturity principle is not restricted to biology. A universe created to support life requires cosmological maturity - stable stellar illumination, gravitational architecture, celestial navigation, seasonal cycles, dynamical stability - no less than biological maturity.

CRE-007.name: Operational completeness does not entail deception
CRE-007.notes: UPGRADED 2026-08-03 from asserted to argued. The stand-up audit recorded that the paper asserted this without argument; JD's Origins Framework (point 2) supplies one by generalizing the maturity pattern beyond Creation Week - the wine at Cana, healings that skip the normal biological process. The Cana wine had chemical properties a chemist would date to years of fermentation and deceived no one, because deception requires an intent to induce false belief and a functional artifact produced for a stated function makes no claim about its own provenance. Combined with EPI-001 (the chronological inference is supplied by the observer's priors, not asserted by the artifact), the deception charge does not attach. RESIDUAL: the argument is strongest for CONFIGURATIONS (mature wine, mature tree). Distant records of PROCESSES with internal duration and cross-channel consistency (OPN-010) are a harder case, and the reply there runs through the functional purpose of the luminaries (HER-002) rather than through the Cana analogy directly.
CRE-007.risk_if_false: If the distinction from appearance-of-age cannot be sustained, the programme inherits the omphalos objection in full and its theological warrant is undercut by its own doctrine of God.
CRE-007.statement: CAC does not assert that God fabricated a fictitious history. It asserts that the created state was sufficient to accomplish its intended purposes immediately. This is functionality, not false testimony, and is distinct from nineteenth-century appearance-of-age arguments.

CRE-008.name: Deep time is not necessary
CRE-008.notes: Hold this at its stated strength. "Not necessary" is defensible; "false" is a much stronger claim the programme has not argued and does not need. Over-reading it is the most likely way to turn a sound modal point into an unsupported one.
CRE-008.risk_if_false: If deep time were entailed by the corpus rather than inferred under auxiliary assumptions, CAC's boundary condition would be inconsistent with the data it accepts (EXT-002) rather than an alternative reading of it, and the programme would be refuted at the core rather than at the belt.
CRE-008.statement: Given that the biblical narrative is authoritative (CRE-001) and that God produces systems functionally mature (CRE-003), it is reasonable to reject the hypothesis of deep time as NECESSARY. The claim is modal: what is denied is the entailment from the observational corpus to a multi-Gyr history, not the consistency of that history with the corpus.

CRE-009.name: Contingency requires a non-contingent actualizing source
CRE-009.notes: DELIBERATELY CARRIES NO DEPENDENCY EDGE TO EXT-001. The four attributes named here - non-contingent, logical, informational, actualizable - are recognisably TRT's primitives in theological register, and drawing a dependency edge would re-assert the "naturally derives from TRT" claim that OPN-008 withdrew. The convergence is real and worth stating in prose; it is not a derivation in either direction, and the registry must not imply one. WHAT IT DOES AND DOES NOT DELIVER. It grounds actualization as the required category. It does NOT deliver discreteness, functional maturity, or any timeline - those are CRE-002, CRE-003 and CRE-008, argued on separate grounds. A contingency argument establishes that there is a non-contingent source; it says nothing about the temporal profile of what that source does. Reading more out of it than that is the same over-reading CRE-008's notes warn against.
CRE-009.risk_if_false: If contingency did not require a non-contingent source, actualization would be one optional description of the origin among others, and CRE-002's "actualization rather than culmination" would be a preference rather than a requirement. The programme would still be statable but would lose the reason its central category is the right one.
CRE-009.statement: The universe is contingent and does not account for its own existence. It therefore requires a source that is non-contingent, logical, informational, and actualizable - the Logos. This is the metaphysical ground of the creative act CRE-002 asserts: actualization is not merely the category CAC prefers for the origin of the cosmos, it is the category a contingent order requires.

EPI-001.name: Apparent age is prior-dependent, not observed
EPI-001.notes: CORRECT AS EPISTEMOLOGY, and it is the right reply to a large class of "but it LOOKS old" objections: the inference is theory-laden and the prior is doing the work. BUT IT IS DEFENSIVE ONLY, and the programme must describe it as such. Bayes has two factors and this claim addresses one. CAC has not specified P(E | H_CAC) - see OPN-011 - so the recommended prior shift cannot actually be COMPUTED, only asserted. Worse, absent a likelihood, ANY observation can be absorbed by "your priors generated that inference", which is the unfalsifiability charge in its strongest form and is precisely why the progressiveness ledger reads zero. Neutralizing an objection is not producing a claim.
EPI-001.risk_if_false: If age determinations were prior-independent - genuinely read off the data without auxiliary assumption - then CRE-008's modal claim collapses and the observational corpus would directly contradict the programme's interval.
EPI-001.statement: "This system appears old" is not an observation. It is a posterior, computed from data under a likelihood and a prior. Standard practice assigns effectively zero prior weight to discrete divine actualization, so the posterior concentrates on deep time largely independently of the data. Systems that appear old therefore reflect a set of naturalistic Bayesian priors that do not take CRE-001 and CRE-003 into account.

EPI-002.name: Methodological designism
EPI-002.notes: Its DEFENSIVE use is obvious - it blocks the charge that CAC licenses arbitrary miracle-invocation. Its CONSTRUCTIVE use is more important and currently unexploited: if law is the norm, everything after Creation Week is ordinary physics acting on an actualized initial configuration, which is a substantive and falsifiable claim that does not require relitigating apparent age. This is where the discriminator hunt should concentrate (OPN-006, OPN-007). It also imposes a COST DISCIPLINE the programme must self-enforce: if intervention is the exception, invoking it is expensive. Every appeal to actualization to explain what ordinary law could have produced is a withdrawal from falsifiable content - and under EPI-002 that is a violation of CAC's own commitments, not merely a strategic error.
EPI-002.risk_if_false: Without it the programme cannot be tested at all: any observation could be attributed to ongoing intervention. This is the claim that makes CAC a candidate research programme rather than a position.
EPI-002.statement: Divine intervention is by definition the exception and not the rule. Methodological designism - conduct inquiry expecting stable law, while holding the metaphysics open - is therefore a reasonable normative operational model. This is the methodological face of CRE-005.

external_citations: Longmire, J.D. (2026). Triadic Reality Theory, v0.9. github.com/jdlongmire/triadic-reality-theory
EXT-001.name: TRT ontology - reality as constrained information in action
EXT-001.notes: The import is at the level of ONTOLOGY only. TRT's belt-level cosmology (ADCE) is NOT imported. Their relation was dispositioned 2026-08-03 as COMMON ONTOLOGY, DIVERGENT BELTS - see OPN-008, EXT-003, and 1-hypothesis/relation-to-trt.md. The import supplies a formal home for actualization-as-primitive-act; it does NOT supply an argument for discreteness, since the core underdetermines the temporal profile of A in both directions (EXT-003).
EXT-001.risk_if_false: CAC loses its ontological setting for "actualization" as a primitive act. The programme could be restated without TRT, but "discrete divine actualization" would then be a theological description with no formal home.
EXT-001.statement: Imported from Triadic Reality Theory: actual reality is constrained information in action, chi = A(I | L), where logic constrains information and actualization produces physical reality. Creation is accordingly the intentional actualization of coherent informational structure rather than the emergence of order from disorder.

EXT-002.name: The observational corpus is accepted as data
EXT-002.notes: This claim is a standing constraint on the belt: no belt hypothesis may proceed by denying a measurement. Specific references are verified per references/verification-status.md before any claim is built on them.
EXT-002.risk_if_false: If the programme were to dispute the measurements rather than their historical interpretation it would be a different and far weaker programme, and would forfeit the position paper's own framing ("The observations remain the same").
EXT-002.statement: The observational corpus of modern cosmology - CMB anisotropy measurements, the distance-redshift relation, BAO, lensing, abundance and structure surveys - is accepted as data. CAC disputes the historical reconstruction placed on it, not the measurements.

external_citations: Longmire, J.D. (2026). ADCE v3.2, section 8, in triadic-reality-theory. Central geometric hypothesis reformulated after falsification criterion 3 fired.
triadic-reality-theory traceability OPN-008: 'The TRT hard core is untouched either way; this is a belt-level physics-facing conjecture.'
EXT-003.name: TRT's core underdetermines the temporal profile of actualization
EXT-003.notes: Cuts both ways and CAC pays for it. Underdetermination means the core does not entail continuity, but equally does not entail discreteness - so the position paper's "CAC naturally derives from TRT" is unavailable and is corrected in v0.2. A finding owed back upstream: TRT does not record this parameter as an open choice on its own side.
EXT-003.risk_if_false: If TRT's core DID fix a temporal profile, one of CAC and ADCE would be inconsistent with the shared ontology rather than a legitimate belt alternative to it, and the OPN-008 disposition would have to be reopened.
EXT-003.statement: TRT's hard core characterizes actualizing action A as a mapping from admissible to actual structure (ACT-001) and fixes no temporal profile for it. Whether A operates at a rate or in an act, continuously or discretely, is not settled by the core. Established by TRT's own registered refutation: ADCE's v2 hypothesis that continued actualization necessarily changes geometry was refuted by red-team and is recorded in ADCE section 8 as false by the paper's own equations - "the capacity bound plus continued actualization therefore constrain a(t) not at all". ADCE's reformulated rate structure is an additional belt-level posit which, in its own words, nothing forces.

external_citations: triadic-reality-theory traceability ONT-003 (four-tier engine), ACT-001 (actualization preserves admissibility; Lean-verified)
EXT-004.name: The four-tier engine imposes a disambiguation obligation on in-transit accounts
EXT-004.notes: This is where the inheritance earns its keep. It converts "CAC should say something about light in transit" into "CAC must assign a tier and declare a status", which is the difference between a gesture and a position. Each declaration carries a bill: actual process => owes a history in which it occurred within the programme's interval (OPN-009/OPN-010 at their hardest); non-actual process => owes the argument that an actual record of a non-actual process is not the deception CRE-007 disclaims.
EXT-004.risk_if_false: If the tiers imposed no such obligation, the TRT import would be decorative - it would supply vocabulary for "actualization" and constrain nothing downstream.
EXT-004.statement: TRT stratifies informational structure as representable, admissible, actual, and outcome-actual (ONT-003), with every actual structure L3-admissible (ACT-001, Lean-verified). A distant record is a physical structure and is therefore actual. The PROCESS the record records must be separately assigned: in chi, or not. TRT does not forbid an actual record of a non-actual process; it forbids leaving the question undeclared. Any CAC account of light in transit must state, per class of distant record, whether the recorded process is actual.

external_citations: triadic-reality-theory 2-theory/04-cosmology/adce.md v3.2.1, sections 9.4 (bridge law carries the dynamical load) and 10 (candidate phenomenological growth laws)
EXT-005.name: ADCE's rate laws are scale-free in the initial stock, so act and rate compose
EXT-005.notes: Established by reading ADCE's own stated laws, NOT by re-running its bridge-law grid scan. That is the limit of the claim's warrant and the reason it is prose_only. This SHARPENS OPN-008's disposition. "Common ontology, divergent belts" was correct that the temporal profile is a free parameter (EXT-003) but overstated the consequence: on the rate-shaped laws the two belts are not rivals at all, since a mature stock plus a growth law is a coherent joint position neither belt stated. The divergence that survives is narrower and lives at OPN-012, where the quantity is the stock rather than its rate.
EXT-005.risk_if_false: If a surviving ADCE branch turned out to depend on the absolute stock rather than on its growth structure, composition would fail for that branch and OPN-008's original divergence framing would be correct for it. One such branch is already known and is registered separately at OPN-012: everpresent Lambda, ADCE's declared rival, scales as V_4^(-1/2) and is a stock-dependent law.
EXT-005.statement: ADCE v3.2 places all dynamical load on the bridge law (its section 9.4), and its candidate laws are rate-shaped rather than stock-shaped. Proportional growth (Nddot = lambda Ndot) yields Ndot proportional to exp(lambda t) and the attractor H* = lambda/3 independently of any initial stock N_0; horizon-coupled growth ties the rate to horizon area, a geometric quantity likewise independent of the absolute count. A functionally mature initial actualized stock is therefore invisible to these laws. CAC's act and ADCE's rate answer different questions - the initial condition and the growth law - and COMPOSE rather than compete.

HER-001.name: Genesis narrates creation from an Earth-local frame
HER-001.notes: Needs development: an observational frame in narrative is not the same as a preferred reference frame in relativistic cosmology, and the slide between the two senses is the first thing a competent critic will press.
HER-001.risk_if_false: Without the Earth-local frame the Day Four reading must supply a global simultaneity convention, which general relativity does not supply freely. The frame claim is doing more physical work than its exegetical form suggests.
HER-001.statement: Genesis consistently narrates creation from Earth's perspective and never adopts an external cosmological viewpoint. Day Four is therefore described relative to Earth's historical frame.

HER-002.name: Day Four establishes covenantal function, not astrophysical chronology
HER-002.notes: Competing readings must be stated and priced (research-practices.md #4): framework, analogical-day, and functional-ontology (Walton) readings each handle the same data. Note that the functional reading is ALSO used by interpreters who reject CRE-001 - borrowing its machinery while rejecting its usual conclusion needs explicit argument.
HER-002.risk_if_false: A functional-appointment reading is what allows Day Four to carry cosmological actualization without committing to a formation narrative. If the text will not bear it, CRE-004 needs a different exegetical support.
HER-002.statement: The Day Four account states the appointment of the luminaries to their functions (signs, seasons, days, years) rather than describing their physical formation history.

HER-003.name: Creation Week is a sequential historical interval
HER-003.notes: Held in the belt deliberately. CRE-001 (Genesis is history) does not by itself settle WHICH historical reading is correct; treating this claim as though it inherited the core's immunity is the belt-promotion failure METHODOLOGY.md names.
HER-003.risk_if_false: Without a sequential interval, "discrete actualization during Creation Week" loses its temporal definiteness and CRE-002 becomes hard to distinguish from an atemporal dependence claim.
HER-003.statement: The days of Genesis 1 denote a sequential historical interval within which the discrete actualization occurred, rather than a literary arrangement of topically grouped material.

OPN-001.name: Mathematical postulates for discrete cosmological actualization
OPN-001.notes: ROADMAP item 1. Gating, but NOT critical path - see OPN-007.
OPN-001.risk_if_false: Without postulates the programme cannot compute, and every belt claim below remains prose. This gates ROADMAP items 2, 3 and 4.
OPN-001.statement: No postulate set has been given for what discrete actualization IS mathematically - what is specified at the boundary, over what manifold, and how the specification connects to the subsequent evolution governed by CRE-005.

OPN-002.name: Model of rapid metric actualization during Day Four
OPN-002.notes: ROADMAP item 3. Any candidate must be consistent with CRE-005 holding immediately afterward.
OPN-002.risk_if_false: PHY-001 is the load-bearing physical hypothesis of the programme; without a model it remains an assertion that something happened.
OPN-002.statement: Whether the Day Four event is representable as rapid metric expansion, as an alternative mechanism, or as a process presently unknown, is left open by the position paper (section 4).

OPN-003.name: Field equations compatible with general relativity
OPN-003.risk_if_false: Without this the programme cannot connect the actualized initial configuration to any present-epoch observation quantitatively.
OPN-003.statement: What formulation of gravitational dynamics holds across the actualization boundary, and in what sense general relativity is retained, suspended, or recovered as a limit.

OPN-004.name: Quantitative model of cosmological redshift
OPN-004.notes: ROADMAP item 4. Must also address the (1+z) light-curve time dilation of OPN-010.
OPN-004.risk_if_false: Redshift is the primary observable through which cosmic history is read. ACC-002 and ACC-003 have no mechanism until this exists.
OPN-004.statement: A quantitative account of the distance-redshift relation under created geometry plus subsequent evolution, reproducing the observed relation across the measured range.

OPN-005.name: CMB implications and the acoustic peak structure
OPN-005.notes: ROADMAP item 5 area. The peaks encode a PROCESS rather than a configuration, which couples this problem tightly to OPN-010 and to CRE-007.
OPN-005.risk_if_false: The peaks are the rival's strongest quantitative ground. Silence here is the single largest gap between CAC and a competitive cosmological model.
OPN-005.statement: Whether the blackbody spectrum, isotropy, and acoustic peak structure of the CMB admit an account under actualized initial conditions plus subsequent ordinary law.

OPN-006.name: Large-scale structure formation
OPN-006.notes: This is the degeneration watch-point named in the appraisal log.
OPN-006.risk_if_false: If structure must be specified rather than grown, the maturity principle absorbs an increasing share of the explanatory work and the programme's content declines toward 'it was made that way', which forbids nothing.
OPN-006.statement: Whether observed large-scale structure - the filamentary web, the correlation function, cluster abundance evolution - follows from an actualized initial configuration under ordinary gravitational law.

OPN-007.name: Observational discriminators distinguishing CAC from LCDM
OPN-007.notes: ROADMAP item 6, THE CRITICAL PATH. Everything else can succeed and leave the programme exactly where it is.
OPN-007.risk_if_false: This is the whole question. Until one exists the programme is unappraisable in Lakatos's sense and the appraisal verdict cannot move off UNAPPRAISED, however much belt machinery accumulates.
OPN-007.statement: At least one observation that CAC forbids and LCDM permits, or that CAC permits and LCDM forbids, stated with its evaluation protocol in advance.

OPN-008.name: Consistency with TRT's belt-level cosmology (ADCE) - RESOLVED
OPN-008.notes: Opened at stand-up by reading ADCE directly rather than the position paper's section 7 summary. Closed the same day on TRT's own registered refutation rather than on a compromise between the programmes. COST CARRIED, not dropped: underdetermination means the core does not entail discreteness either, so section 7's "naturally derives from" is wrong and becomes "adopts the ontology of" in v0.2. Produced two results: EXT-003 (the free parameter) and EXT-004 (the disambiguation obligation, which constrains OPN-010). SHARPENED 2026-08-04 on JD's observation that ADCE's structure could itself have originated functionally mature. "Divergent belts" was too strong: it was right about the free parameter and wrong about the consequence. Act and rate answer different questions - initial condition versus growth law - and on ADCE's rate-shaped laws they compose into a joint position neither belt stated (EXT-005). The divergence that survives is narrower and stock-shaped, at OPN-012. WHAT THE SHARPENING DOES NOT CHANGE: compatibility is PERMISSION, NOT DERIVATION. The underdetermination argument that establishes it is the same one that killed section 7's "naturally derives from", and keeping only the favourable half would be the conventionalist twist in CAC's own favour. Nor are the cores equally warranted - TRT claims immunity by necessity (the denial of L3 is self-refuting), CAC by methodological decision, and CAC cannot inherit TRT's warrant by adopting its ontology.
OPN-008.risk_if_false: If TRT's core did fix a temporal profile for A, the disposition reopens and one of the two belts is inconsistent with the shared ontology rather than an alternative development of it. EXT-003 is the load-bearing premise; it rests on a refutation TRT registered against its own hypothesis, which is strong evidence but is a single source.
OPN-008.statement: RESOLVED 2026-08-03 (PI-1 O2a), SHARPENED 2026-08-04. Disposition: COMPATIBLE CORES, COMPOSABLE BELTS. The two hard cores share no proposition on which they could disagree - TRT's constrains the form and status of the actual (the central identity, the three primitives, the four-tier engine) and fixes no content, occasion or duration for any particular actualization; CAC's makes historical and content claims about one actualization event. Every CAC commitment is one TRT's core leaves open, and no TRT commitment is one CAC denies. The belts differ on the temporal profile of actualizing action, a parameter TRT's core genuinely leaves free (EXT-003), and TRT's own registry says so: "The TRT hard core is untouched either way." The 2026-08-04 sharpening: on ADCE's rate-shaped bridge laws the belts do not merely coexist, they COMPOSE - a mature initial stock is invisible to a scale-free growth law (EXT-005). Neither belt is positioned to supersede the other - ADCE's severe test failed across the natural bridge-law grid in every cell, and CAC has zero predictions.

OPN-009.name: Light travel time from cosmological distances
OPN-009.notes: NOT named in the position paper; added at stand-up. VSOK objective O1, KR1.1. Existing young-cosmos treatments (relativistic time-dilation cosmologies, alternative synchrony conventions, in-transit creation) should be surveyed and priced rather than reinvented.
OPN-009.risk_if_false: This is the first objection any competent reader raises. A programme that cannot state its position is not yet in the conversation.
OPN-009.statement: Under CRE-004, what accounts for light presently arriving from sources at cosmological distance. Axiom 4's Earth-frame reading and section 4's rapid actualization gesture at an answer; neither supplies one.

OPN-010.name: Processes observed in transit
OPN-010.notes: NOT named in the position paper; added at stand-up. Flagged in the ROADMAP as the most promising place to look for OPN-007, on the reasoning that maximum exposure and maximum discriminating power are the same property. Since the OPN-008 disposition (2026-08-03) the option space is narrower and better defined: EXT-004 forbids leaving the recorded process's status undeclared, and each of the two available declarations carries a stated bill.
OPN-010.risk_if_false: This is the sharpest form of the omphalos objection and bears directly on CRE-007's claim that operational completeness does not entail deception. If unanswerable, CRE-007 fails and the theological warrant is undercut by the programme's own doctrine of God.
OPN-010.statement: Distant observations record not merely arrived light but PROCESSES WITH INTERNAL DURATION: Type Ia supernova light curves time-dilated as (1+z), the SN 1987A ring light-echo geometry, quasar variability, binary pulsar spin-down. A created-in-transit account must explain the observed internal consistency of processes apparently unfolding at distance, not only the arrival of the light. Per EXT-004 the account must additionally DECLARE, per class of record, whether the recorded process is actual in TRT's sense.

OPN-011.name: CAC has no likelihood function
OPN-011.notes: Registered 2026-08-03 when JD's Origins Framework stated the apparent-age argument in explicitly Bayesian terms. Holding the argument to its own standard is what surfaced the gap - the framework names the factor standard practice gets wrong and, in doing so, names exactly the factor CAC has not supplied. This now SUPERSEDES OPN-010 as the sharpest open problem. OPN-010 asked the programme to state a position on processes in transit; the Origins Framework states one (see OPN-010's own notes). What remains is not a position but a FUNCTION, and it is the same function OPN-007 needs. Where to start: EPI-002's constructive limb, since ordinary law acting on a specified initial state has computable consequences and is the one place the likelihood is not hostage to the creation act itself. TWO CANDIDATE ROUTES REGISTERED 2026-08-04, both from the Origins Framework v0.2 pass. PRD-001.name: Historical complexity asymmetry
PRD-001.notes: THE VECTOR IS NOT AGGREGATED, DELIBERATELY. A composite index with four inputs and no weights is LESS falsifiable than a single scalar, because any mixed outcome reads as confirmation to whoever already holds the thesis. Parameter count alone was rejected for the opposite reason (Goodhart: a framework can grow more elaborate without adding free parameters, or shed one while its architecture thickens). The resolution is a vector with per-component directions fixed in advance and a majority decision rule. ONE COMPONENT CURRENTLY POINTS AGAINST THE THESIS, recorded here rather than discovered later: H4 has arguably moved the wrong way for CAC across Planck 2013 -> 2015 -> 2018, since central values for age, H0 and Omega_m tightened substantially. The Hubble tension is a discrepancy BETWEEN METHODS, which is not the same measurement as drift in a single reconstruction across releases. If H4 keeps converging the claim loses one of four components immediately. BASELINE OWED. No trajectory is measurable without a t_0. Fixing the counting conventions for H1-H3 and recording current values is the first task under this claim; until then PRD-001 is a stated prediction with an unexecuted protocol. WHAT KIND OF PREDICTION THIS IS. A programme-level appraisal claim about the trajectory of a rival's model development - a legitimate Lakatosian object, falsifiable under the rule above. It is NOT a novel-fact prediction about nature: it forbids a pattern in how models evolve, not an observation of the world. OPN-011 remains open and this claim does not answer it. The ledger now reads one prediction; it should not be read as one novel-fact prediction. METHODOLOGICAL RECIPROCITY. CAC is evaluated by the same standard. Should it require an indefinitely expanding body of auxiliary hypotheses without corresponding predictive success, it is degenerative in the same sense. Mechanized advisory at 0-program-methods/ops/reciprocity_check.py rather than left as prose.
PRD-001.risk_if_false: Refutation would remove the programme's only prediction and return the ledger to zero novel content, with the additional cost that the refuting pattern - historical models simplifying and converging as precision improves - is positive evidence FOR continuous natural history rather than merely absence of evidence for CAC.
PRD-001.statement: As observational precision increases, OPERATIONAL models of the present universe will continue to converge toward greater predictive accuracy, while HISTORICAL models that assume uninterrupted natural development will exhibit increasing historical explanatory burden. The prediction is the ASYMMETRY between the two limbs, not complexity growth as such: mature programmes generically accumulate structure under increasing precision (the Standard Model carries ~19 free parameters and has no historical boundary conditions to be wrong about), so complexity alone discriminates nothing. On the generic account both limbs complexify together; on CAC they separate. Burden is measured by the Historical Explanatory Burden Index (HEBI), a VECTOR of four independently reported components - H1 inferred cosmological components, H2 adjustable parameters in leading historical models, H3 competing extensions surviving to a subsequent data release, H4 stability of age and expansion-history reconstructions across releases - against operational control O1 (measurement precision, predictive residuals, reproducibility, independent agreement).
